mechanisms.behavior: ROM labels TROUGH 1-6 and TROUGH JAM are preserved. Startup closes public 18-21; 16,17 and 22 start open. After six coin pulses and START BUTTON 13 the ROM pulsed solenoid 1 at physical level 210; it stopped after the harness opened 18 and asserted shooter input 1. This is a simulated transfer after a ROM-driven serve, not physical verification of a six-ball trough, four installed balls, opto construction, ejection geometry or drain behavior. Retained VPX script evidence (lines 177-188 and 516-562): the recreation initializes four balls on swTrough1-4, maps its five table trough kickers to inputs 21-17, locally advances a ball toward the eject end after occupancy changes, sends Drain to that local chain, and lets sol.1 kick swTrough1 toward the shooter lane. This is table-only topology and a simulated route; no physical trough count, sixth/jam sensor fitment, drain path, geometry, or construction is established. Independent primary photograph supreme.factory-ball-label shows the factory instruction INSTALL 4 BALLS on the photographed Supreme. This corroborates four installed balls for that example; it does not settle trough sensor count, jam fitment, contact construction, wiring, serial or firmware variants. Shared-design candidate only: Spider-Man The Pin manual 780-50H8-00 p.22: 500-9820-4BALL Trough Assembly. The donor part, wiring, fitted quantity and complete physical behavior have not been confirmed for Supreme; no Supreme assembly part number is asserted from this reference.
mechanisms.label: ROM trough and ball-serve logic

mechanisms.behavior: With public shooter input 1 asserted after a proven trough pulse, LAUNCH BUTTON 15 closed for 150 ms and the ROM pulsed AUTO PLUNGER solenoid 2 at 191. Input 1 then opened. Retained VPX script evidence (lines 190-197 and 564-567): an impulse helper is attached to swShooter and switch 1; sol.2 calls its AutoFire method. The visible manual Plunger object is operated from the plunger key separately (lines 319-370). The output placement is therefore a shooter-trigger projection, not proof that a physical auto launcher shares the manual plunger's assembly, stroke, or path.
